model.api_availability_probe: NOT_PERFORMED: a models or messages call is a provider call, which this mission forbids; availability rests on the documentation
model.substitution: NONE: a model change is a separate operator decision because it changes the packet

pricing.basis: standard price (the introductory price is now the standard price)
pricing.multiplier_reason: the request sends no inference_geo, so a workspace default applies that this repository cannot observe; the dearer documented reading is applied
pricing.prompt_caching: NOT_USED: the request sends no cache_control, so cache pricing does not apply

limits.strict_mode_injected_prompt_tokens: NOT_ESTABLISHED: documented to exist and to be billed, size not documented
limits.local_tokenizer: NOT_PUBLISHED: token counts come from the token-counting endpoint, which would transmit the text, and are documented as estimates

data_use.training: Customer Content from the API is not used for training (Commercial Terms); retained data is never used for training without express permission
data_use.retention: API inputs and outputs deleted within 30 days of receipt or generation, except longer-retention services under the customer's control, a separate agreement such as ZDR, Usage Policy enforcement (flagged content up to 2 years, classification scores up to 7 years) and legal compliance
data_use.retention_reading: the stricter of the two first-party statements is bound: 30 days plus the exceptions
